messages:
sam_ops: Heads up — local recorder on Stage 2 just dropped frames ~2m ago during the demo. Live stream is still up but captions are lagging. Can someone triage? @alice? @infra-bot?

alice: On it. Switching OBS to backup scene and enabling fallback captions. Which recorder host has the iso?

ben: I can grab the iso from record01. Path should be /mnt/recordings/iso/allhands-2026-03-23/record01/

carla: I restarted `recorderd` on record01 a minute ago. Logs show a transient disk I/O spike, then service recovered. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T14:12:03Z] recorderd ERROR: write timeout to /dev/nvme1n1 (retrying)
[2026-03-23T14:12:07Z] recorderd INFO: resumed writing segments
```

infra-bot: deploybot: restarted pack `recorderd` on record01 successfully. No config changes.

sam_ops: Good. Switching captions to GCP live-transcribe fallback now. Jen, do you want to pause Q/A or continue and capture missed ones?

jen (CEO): Continue the session. Don't pause. Collect any questions that were missed and I'll answer the top 3 after.

alice: Backup OBS scene is live, stream bitrates stable (4500kbps), captions fallback enabled. No dropped frames since switch.

ben: Starting copy of iso to S3: `aws s3 cp /mnt/recordings/iso/allhands-2026-03-23/record01/ s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record01/ --recursive --quiet` — ETA ~3m. I'll post link when done.

carla: Partial segments present for 14:09–14:13. I'll splice and tag with timecodes, then upload. Action items logged: 1) verify captions transcript, 2) postmortem doc, 3) confirm retention for iso. Sam, assigning the postmortem to you?

sam_ops: Assigned — I'll own the postmortem. Also: please timestamp any audience Qs we missed and drop them in #post-allhands-questions. @qa-lyn can you compile unanswered Qs?

qa-lyn: Yep. I'll pull chat, the Q&A sheet and the stream timestamps, then send a tidy list to leadership. Noting one missed question about "roadmap migration timeline" that popped at 14:11.

jen (CEO): Thanks. Please cc me on the Q list and postmortem. We'll do a 30-min follow-up in next all-hands to address missed roadmap asks.

stream-monitor: monitor: captions fallback active, 1.2% packet loss at edge for last 5m, overall latency +1.4s; metrics steady.

sam_ops: OK team — thanks for the quick pivots. Postmortem draft by EOD, iso and transcripts uploaded, and we'll surface missed Qs to leadership. If anyone has raw clips they want preserved, drop paths here. :thumbsup:
